scope: Combined root vowel drop and consonant softening
findings: RootTrie builds softened and dropped variants separately, never their combination.
Production morphology rejects kaybı/kaybımızdan/kaydımızdan, while accepting kaypı/kayıbı/kaytı/kayıdı and their tested long forms.
Other combined target surfaces can be accepted via alternative production paths; acceptance alone does not prove target root generated combined alternation.
Test-only explicitly combined stem roots with harmony seeds accept all10 intended forms.
limits: Explicit combined stems are diagnostic only, not proposed bare-word lexicon additions.
nakti/akti/ahti probes rejected; prior harmony-loss findings affect those dropped variants too.
root_cause: Independent variant construction omits softened+dropped root variant.
